how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-the-deadmines-01-r2.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:214:obj:0: ⟦E1⟧ at the Sentinel Hill Tower wants you to bring her 10 ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:214:details:0: It's no secret that the trademark of the Defias Gang is their Red Bandanas. But we've learned that the material from which these bandanas are made signifies the member's rank.
rows.quest:214:details:1: That being said, I want you to eliminate as many high ranking Defias members as you can. The highest ranking members will undoubtedly be found in VanCleef's secret hideout. When you're done bring me 10 ⟦E2⟧ as proof of their deaths and I will reward you. Good luck, ⟦1⟧.
rows.quest:214:progress:0: Have you been reclaiming our land from the Defias gang? If so show me 10 ⟦E2⟧ as proof.
rows.quest:214:completion:0: Well done, ⟦2⟧! On behalf of ⟦E4⟧ I salute you for your efforts. Soon we will return this land to the people with help from brave souls like you.
rows.quest:168:obj:0: Retrieve 4 Miners' Union Cards and return them to ⟦E5⟧ in ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:168:details:0: Many of my friends perished that horrible day when the mine tunnel caved in. If your adventures happen to bring you into that wing of the mine in Moonbrook, please keep an eye out for any sign which might identify them. If you come across any of their Miners' Union Cards, bring them back to me and I'll make sure their families get some resolution from this horrible accident.
rows.quest:168:progress:0: Were you able to retrieve any of my old co-worker's Miners' Union Cards?
rows.quest:168:completion:0: Thank you for collecting these, ⟦3⟧. Your efforts will help bring peace to the dead in the wake of this tragedy. I will see to it that the families are notified.
rows.quest:167:obj:0: Bring ⟦E7⟧ Thistlenettle's Explorers' League Badge to ⟦E5⟧ in ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:167:details:0: We were deep in a vast mine in ⟦E8⟧, hidden beneath a barn in Moonbrook. No clue where these stinkin' thieving types came from. Anyway, the mine tunnel collapsed on us. I got out but the others... well... the others haven't been heard from.
rows.quest:167:details:1: You look like you might have better luck in there. If you could look for my brother, I'd be thankful. He always carried his Explorers' League Badge. If you can't find him, that badge would at least give me some peace of mind.
rows.quest:167:progress:0: Did you find any sign of my brother? Is there any hope after all this time?
rows.quest:167:completion:0: My suspicions were correct. My poor brother.... Well, thank you for bringing some conclusion to this mystery, even if the conclusion was grim.
rows.quest:2040:obj:0: Retrieve the ⟦E9⟧ from the Deadmines and return it to ⟦E10⟧ in ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:2040:details:0: ⟦E11⟧ has fallen under the control of those dastardly troggs! The situation is grave but perhaps you can help, ⟦4⟧.
rows.quest:2040:details:1: Deep in the Deadmines is a functional goblin shredder. Find that shredder and bring back the intact power supply. With the shredder's power supply, we can give our gyrodrillmatic excavationators the power they need to break through the rocky underground borders of ⟦E11⟧, opening the way for a gnomish assault!
rows.quest:2040:completion:0: Well done, ⟦6⟧. Thanks to you, ⟦E11⟧ is one step closer to its day of liberation!
rows.quest:166:obj:0: Kill Edwin VanCleef and bring his head to ⟦E12⟧.
rows.quest:166:details:0: There is but one task left for you to complete. Edwin VanCleef must be assassinated. While it saddens me to condemn any man to a death sentence, it is for the greater good of the people of ⟦E8⟧ that VanCleef is laid to rest once and for all. Bring me the villain's head once the deed is done.
rows.quest:166:progress:0: How goes the hunt for Edwin VanCleef?
rows.quest:166:completion:0: ⟦7⟧, your bravery is remarkable. ⟦E4⟧ thanks you for your service to the people of ⟦E8⟧. With VanCleef dead, this marks the beginning of the end for the Defias Brotherhood. Hopefully some day soon peace will once again grace the plains of this fair land.
